properties.name: Dependency currency as of 2026-09-13 — tantivy is already latest, rust is one patch behind, and the only real staleness is the rocksdb wrapper a decision already told us to replace
properties.statement:
READ FROM Cargo.lock AND rustc 2026-09-13, prompted by @ajs asking what tantivy version is in use. Recorded so the answer does not have to be re-derived; the audit itself is NOT pressing and was explicitly deprioritised behind the flo2 items.

RESOLVED VERSIONS:

    tantivy    0.26.1    <- ALREADY THE LATEST RELEASE. Nothing to do.
    rocksdb    0.24.0    <- the stale one, see below
    rmcp        3.3.0
    tokio      1.53.0
    clap        4.6.2
    serde     1.0.228
    rustc      1.98.0    (1.98.1 is current; no rust-toolchain.toml pins it)

⭐ THE ONE THAT MATTERS IS ALREADY DECIDED AND NOT DONE. `rocksdb = "0.24"` is the historically-unmaintained wrapper. `dec:absorb-rocksdb-024-unchanged-then-switch-separately` is ACCEPTED and says the switch to the maintained `rust-rocksdb` (0.52 at the time it was written) gets its OWN PR, deliberately kept out of the absorption so a failure would have one cause. That PR has not been opened. This is the actual dependency debt — not a sweep of everything.

⚠️ NO `rust-toolchain.toml` EXISTS, so the toolchain is whatever the machine has. fact:a-gate-is-only-as-wide-as-the-toolchain-that-runs-it already records the cost of that here: every clippy gate passed locally and both CI jobs failed on the same lint, because the COMPILER was the narrow gate and the flags were identical. A pinned toolchain would have made that visible; that is a stronger argument for pinning than currency is.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: no `cargo outdated` or `cargo audit` was run. Only the six crates named above were checked, against versions known to me rather than queried from crates.io, so "latest" is asserted for tantivy on @ajs's word and for the others not at all. The full sweep this decision asks for — 20 crate-local pins against 8 shared, four crates pinned twice — has not been done.

2026-10-01 — THE FULL SWEEP THIS SAYS WAS NOT DONE HAS BEEN DONE: fact:dependency-audit-2026-10-01-the-full-sweep, covering all 35 direct crates against crates.io plus the GitHub Actions. The versions above have moved (rmcp is locked at 3.4.0 with 3.5.0 out, tokio 1.53.1, clap 4.6.7, serde 1.0.229, tantivy 0.26.2, rustc 1.99.0 stable). The conclusion that matters here still stands: the rust-rocksdb switch is the real dependency debt, and its PR is still unopened. Partly overtaken, so it stays open.
